**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
Many people often use `Recent items` feature to open the folder or file they recently open, sometimes people also wanted to open file location - where the file is located. And the problem is, it will be difficult for users to find which file it is when the folder consists of many files and /.or folders.

**Describe the solution**
Try to focus the files when users click on Open file location.
